name: Rosalia Carlier
source:
Affiliation: 5th Corps, transferred to the Intelligence Bureau
Rank: First Lieutenant

A lady who was once the daughter of a noble family.
Desiring to exact revenge, she became a soldier.
She's ill-tempered and argumentative.

[Translation of [URL=http://sunset77light.rdy.jp/3rai/cha.html]official website profile[/URL].]
